functionalRequirement: User shall be able to share files, screen share, conduct group screen sharing, and send contacts.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: File sharing and screen sharing operations must complete within 5 seconds for files up to 100 MB, with less than 200ms latency for screen sharing.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures quick and responsive file and screen sharing functionality for user satisfaction.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: All shared files and screen content must be encrypted using AES-256 during transmission and at rest.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protects sensitive information during file and screen sharing operations.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Fault Tolerance: The system must support automatic resumption of interrupted file transfers and maintain session integrity during screen sharing.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures reliable file sharing and screen sharing experiences under varying network conditions.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: Implement file size limits (max 1 GB), file type restrictions, and clear error messages for unsupported sharing attempts.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides guidance and prevents user errors during file and contact sharing.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Interoperability: Support file sharing across multiple device types (Windows, macOS, iOS, Android) with consistent functionality.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures the sharing feature works seamlessly across different platforms.

functionalRequirement: User shall be able to sign up and validate credentials, leading to access to the Snap camera screen.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Authentication: Implement multi-factor authentication with at least two verification methods (password + SMS/email code).
identifiedNFRs.justification: Enhances security during user sign-up and credential validation process.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Learnability: Provide clear, step-by-step guidance during sign-up process with inline validation and helpful error messages.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Simplifies the user registration process and reduces friction.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: Maintain 99.99% uptime for the authentication and credential validation system.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures users can consistently access the sign-up and login functionality.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: Complete credential validation and screen access within 2 seconds for 95% of login attempts.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides a responsive login experience for users.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Password Policy: Enforce strong password requirements (minimum 12 characters, mix of uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and special characters).
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures robust credential security during user registration.

functionalRequirement: System shall provide an interface for Application Administrators to reset user passwords.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Authenticity: Implement role-based access control (RBAC) with multi-factor authentication for administrator password reset actions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures only authorized administrators can reset user passwords.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Analysability: Log all password reset attempts with timestamp, administrator ID, and user affected for audit purposes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides traceability and helps in monitoring administrative actions.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Assistance: Provide clear audit trail and confirmation mechanisms for each password reset action.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Helps administrators understand and verify password reset operations.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Recoverability: Implement a mechanism to revert password reset actions within 5 minutes of execution.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Allows correction of unintended password reset actions.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: Complete password reset process within 3 seconds for 99% of reset attempts.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures quick and efficient administrative password management.

functionalRequirement: System shall be able to perform distance calculations and access geo-location information for the user, sites, and nearby sites.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must accurately calculate distances between user, sites, and nearby sites using all required geo-location data types (e.g., latitude, longitude) for 100% of specified use cases.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to perform distance calculations and access geo-location information, necessitating full coverage of these core functional aspects.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must calculate distances between user, sites, and nearby sites in less than 100 milliseconds for up to 1,000 concurrent requests.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures timely responses for geo-location data processing.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: Encrypt user geo-location data using TLS 1.3 during transmission and anonymize stored location data.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protects sensitive user location information.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: Maintain 99.95% uptime for geo-location services and distance calculation functionality.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures consistent access to location-based services.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: Provide clear, consistent API documentation for geo-location and distance calculation interfaces.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Facilitates easy integration and use of location services.

functionalRequirement: The system shall allow prospective applicants to research requirements and select relevant services or applications to initiate online.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Engagement: Implement an intuitive search and filtering mechanism with relevance-based ranking of services and applications.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Enhances user experience in finding and selecting appropriate services.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: Load service and application information within 2 seconds, with search results displayed in less than 500 milliseconds.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures responsive and quick access to service information.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: Provide comprehensive information for 100% of listed services, including requirements, eligibility, and application process.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures applicants have full access to necessary information for decision-making.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Interoperability: Support responsive design for seamless access across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Allows applicants to research and select services from any device.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Assistance: Implement contextual help, tooltips, and guided navigation for service selection process.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides support to users during service research and selection.
